quant = SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(raw, annotation=NULL)

Yeah we should change the wording of that section of the manual. The workflow for MSstats is the same, but the output of Skyline needs to be different for DIA.

If you look at page 55 of the manual, the Fragment Ions for DIA are in the format  y12, y8, y6, ect. For DIA we need Skyline to return these fragments, not the precursors ("precursor", "precursor [M+1]", "precursor [M+2]").

I was able to dig up an example Skyline DIA dataset and these are the first couple rows with the correct FragmentIon column.



Hopefully this makes sense!
